_comment: Solo mining via local veriumd JSON-RPC. Edit RPC credentials and coinbase-addr, then: cpuminer -c cpuminer-conf.solo.example.json
_threads: 0 = auto (recommended): picks threads from P-cores, RAM and cache.
_profile: 'dedicated' is typical for solo rigs; 'background' keeps the machine responsive.
_log-file: Optional: append plain-text logs for headless/service runs.
